title: A Day at the Park
text:
Lucas has a blue ball. He plays with it in the park. The ball is big and light.

Today his friend Ana brings a kite. They fly it together. It is very high in the sky.

questions.text: What does Ana bring to the park?
How do Lucas and Ana probably feel about their day?
Why are Lucas and Ana probably outside?
options: Because they like to play outside

vocabulary.definition: a round object that children throw, kick or catch
a public place with grass and trees where people go to relax or play
a light toy that flies in the wind on a long string

paragraph_translations: Lucas tem uma bola azul. Ele brinca com ela no parque. A bola é grande e leve.
Hoje, a amiga dele, Ana, traz uma pipa. Eles soltam a pipa juntos. Ela está muito alta no céu.
